desc:
[DISCLAIMER]; Game is really mechanic intensive and requires real-time strategy. Attempt to complete a class over and over until you can obtain new units and equipments.

The Backrooms is an uncomfortable place filled with reality-breaking areas and unusual entities. Something unknown is driving most of them to attack the people trapped inside, and it's up to you to stop them.

Place your units, defend the path and survive each wave in this co-op tower defense. Team up with up to 3 other players, and face threats that are each unique in their own way.

🖥️ Platforms supported - PC and Mobile
